AI Overview
Orbit Kick is a popular web-browser casual arcade and physics-based sports game published by Azgames. 
orbitkick.io
 +2
Game Overview
In this incremental progression game, you take on the role of a soccer player. The primary goal is simple: kick the soccer ball as far as possible. 
The Core Loop: Kick the ball → earn coins based on the distance traveled → purchase upgrades → kick the ball even farther. 
Control Mechanics: The game relies entirely on a one-click/one-button timing system. A moving power meter swings back and forth; clicking at the precise moment maximizes launch force and sets the perfect trajectory angle. 
orbitkick.io
 +1
Upgrades: Earned coins are spent on three major stat categories:
Power: Boosts the initial strength and launch force of your kick.
Bounce: Increases how well the ball retains momentum and bounces over the terrain after hitting the ground.
Offline Earnings: Allows you to continue generating coins passively when the game is closed. 
Milestones & Content: Reaching specific distance milestones (such as 1,000 meters, 2,000 meters, and beyond) unlocks new levels, unique ball skins, and distinct world landscapes—allowing the ball to soar past landmarks like the Statue of Liberty or the Eiffel Tower, and eventually launch straight into space. 
Platforms & Availability
The game is built using HTML5 technology and is designed to run seamlessly on desktop and mobile web browsers without needing any downloads. It can be found across several web game portals, including OrbitKick.io, Azgames, and Sports Games AZ. 
Are you looking for gameplay tips to maximize your distance, details on its space-themed sequel (Orbit Kick 2), or something else?
